items.title: Shogun Matcha pop-up at Nobu Hotel Atlanta
items.description: Shogun Matcha pours hand-whisked matcha from Uji in the lobby of Nobu Hotel Atlanta in Buckhead, with art on display in the lobby. Walk-ins welcome; the hotel's own post lists these as upcoming matcha pop-ups.
items.notes: Dates and hours quoted from Nobu Atlanta's Instagram post of 2026-11-14 (list: Nov 15, Dec 5, Dec 12, Dec 20); address from hotel listings, not on the post. Price and payment not given. Shogun's Saturday farmers markets ended Nov 21 and resume in April (its Nov 16 post).

items.title: Oohmami Matcha at Gather - Grant Park Market
items.description: Oohmami pours farm-direct Uji matcha at the Gather market inside Grant Park Market, with tins, totes and tumblers for sale.
items.notes: Guess from pattern, not a dated post: Oohmami posts each stop the Wednesday before (Sat 10/31 9-2, Sat 11/14 10-2, Sun 11/22 10-2), so Saturday or Sunday is not fixed. Replaces the pass-1 Oohmami rows, which used the wrong venue (cfmatl Grant Park Farmers Market, Sundays 9-1, whose vendor list never names Oohmami). Check @oohmamimatcha before promoting. checked 2026-11-23: no public page shows a dated Oohmami stop for this day; the Instagram posts were not opened and a web search found nothing.
